name: Genshin Impact
tagline: Working Genshin Impact codes for free Primogems, Mora and Hero's Wit.
description: Genshin Impact is HoYoverse's open-world action RPG, set in the fantasy world of Teyvat. HoYoverse releases new redemption codes during every version livestream (typically the day a new version goes live), plus occasional codes for milestones, partnerships and special events. Livestream codes expire quickly — usually within 24 to 48 hours — so it pays to redeem them the moment they drop. Permanent codes such as GENSHINGIFT remain active for new and returning players.
longDescription:
Genshin Impact is HoYoverse's flagship open-world action RPG. Launched in September 2020, it pioneered the cinematic gacha-RPG genre and now anchors a portfolio that also includes Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero. Set in the continent of Teyvat, players explore seven elemental nations, build a team of characters from a Five-Star-heavy gacha pool, and farm artifact sets to push damage on the limited-time abyss and theatre game modes.

For most players, the limiting resource is **Primogems** — the soft pull currency used on character and weapon banners. A 10-pull costs 1,600 Primogems, and a guaranteed Five-Star character takes on average around 14,000 Primogems if you hit hard pity. The other reward types that codes drop — **Mora** (gold), **Hero's Wit** (character XP books), and **Mystic Enhancement Ore** (weapon XP) — are useful but rarely the actual bottleneck.

Genshin's redemption code system is unusually generous compared to most live-service games. Every version livestream (held the weekend before each new patch goes live) drops three redemption codes worth 300 Primogems combined, plus assorted Mora and books. These livestream codes are short-lived — they expire within 24 to 48 hours of being announced — so they are best redeemed the moment the livestream ends. Permanent codes like `GENSHINGIFT` remain active indefinitely and are a small but free welcome gift for new accounts.
videoTitle: How to redeem Genshin Impact codes — mobile and PC
whatCodesDo:
Genshin Impact codes drop one of four reward types. **Primogems** are the most valuable: each livestream code gives 100 Primogems, and a full livestream sweep (three codes) nets 300 Primogems — about one and a half wishes on a banner, or one-fortieth of a guaranteed Five-Star at hard pity. The permanent `GENSHINGIFT` code also pays out 50 Primogems for any new account.

**Mora** is the gold-equivalent currency, used for character ascension, talent levelling, and artifact upgrades. Codes typically drop 10,000 to 50,000 Mora — a small contribution against a Five-Star talent grind that needs around 1.7M Mora end-to-end, but free is free. **Hero's Wit** are blue books that grant 20,000 character XP each; codes usually drop three to five at a time. **Mystic Enhancement Ore** are the weapon equivalents.

Occasionally codes drop **specialty cooking ingredients** (Jueyun Chili, Stir-Fried Fish Noodles, Tandem Turnovers) which are food buffs useful for combat — the in-game banner usually credits these to the regional event the code commemorates. Strategically, livestream-code Primogems should be saved for whichever banner is closest to your pity timer; do not waste them on a featured banner you do not actually want pulls on, because Genshin Primogems carry over indefinitely.
whereToFindMore: New Genshin Impact codes are announced during the official HoYoverse [version preview livestreams](https://www.hoyolab.com/circles/2), held the weekend before each version goes live. The livestream is broadcast on the official HoYoverse YouTube channel, and the redemption codes are revealed in three timed bursts during the broadcast. Mirror posts go up on the [official Twitter / X account](https://twitter.com/GenshinImpact), the [Genshin Impact subreddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/Genshin_Impact/), and the HoYoLab community app within minutes. We refresh this page within an hour of the livestream end, and bookmark the [latest codes view](/genshin-impact/latest) for the cleanest list — livestream codes expire fast, so speed matters.
releaseCadence: Genshin Impact has the most predictable code schedule of any game in this site's catalogue. **Three livestream codes** drop in every version preview livestream, held roughly six weeks apart. Each is worth 100 Primogems plus assorted Mora and books, and **each expires within 24 to 48 hours** of being announced. **Permanent codes** like `GENSHINGIFT` are added once or twice per year and stay redeemable indefinitely. **Event codes** appear sporadically — anniversary celebrations, partnership crossovers, regional event promotions — and typically last between five and fourteen days. Given the consistency of the livestream cadence, the next code drop will land on the weekend immediately before the next version goes live; check the HoYoverse Twitter account a few days ahead for the exact stream time.
expiredCodesContext: Genshin Impact's livestream code window is one of the shortest in any major live-service game — usually 24 to 48 hours from drop to expiry. The codes archived below all paid out at some point in the past six months; almost all of them were livestream codes from earlier version preview broadcasts that wound down within two days. We keep the archive live so returning players can quickly confirm a code they saw in a YouTube thumbnail or compatibility thread is genuinely dead before contacting support, and so the addition / expiry dates document HoYoverse's livestream calendar at a glance.

redeemSteps.title: Reach Adventure Rank 10
redeemSteps.detail: Your account must be at least AR 10 before the code redemption portal will accept any code. New players: complete the Statue of the Seven quest in Mondstadt as part of the opening campaign, and you will hit AR 10 within an hour of starting. The redemption endpoint silently rejects sub-AR 10 accounts — there is no error message, the code just refuses to apply.

redeemSteps.title: Open the redemption portal
redeemSteps.detail: Go to the official HoYoverse redemption page at [genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/gift](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/gift). On mobile only, you can also redeem in-game via Paimon menu → Settings → Account → Redeem Now, which deep-links to the same portal. The PC and PlayStation builds do not have an in-game redemption button — you must use the web portal.

redeemSteps.title: Log in and pick your server
redeemSteps.detail: Sign in with the HoYoverse account that owns your Genshin Impact profile (the email, mobile, or social login linked to that account). On the portal, select the correct server: America, Europe, Asia, or TW/HK/MO. Each server is a separate gacha pool and a separate redemption registry — redeem on the wrong server and the code is consumed without paying out.

redeemSteps.title: Paste the code and submit
redeemSteps.detail: Copy a code from this page using the Copy button next to it. Paste it character-for-character into the code box on the portal. Genshin codes are case-sensitive and almost always all uppercase — `GENSHINGIFT` and `genshingift` are not the same. Hit Submit and confirm on the modal that appears.

redeemSteps.title: Claim rewards from in-game mail
redeemSteps.detail: Primogems, Mora, and items arrive via in-game mail within five minutes of a successful redemption. Open the Paimon menu, tap Mail, and claim the rewards from the entry labelled 'Redemption Code'. Mail is held for 30 days before being purged, so claim it within the window even if you are not pulling immediately.

troubleshooting.cause: The code has expired (livestream codes only last 24 to 48 hours), or you typed it on the wrong case. Genshin codes are case-sensitive and almost always uppercase.
troubleshooting.fix: Cross-check against our [Expired Codes archive](/genshin-impact/expired). If it is not there, copy-paste it directly from our Active table rather than retyping.

troubleshooting.symptom: Red error: 'Code has already been used'
troubleshooting.cause: Each code is one-time per HoYoverse account per server. If you have already redeemed it on this server, the portal will reject the second attempt.
troubleshooting.fix: If you have the same HoYoverse account on multiple servers, the same code can be redeemed once per server. Switch the server dropdown on the portal.

troubleshooting.symptom: Code accepted but no rewards in mail
troubleshooting.cause: The portal returns 'success' instantly but the in-game mail can take up to five minutes to arrive — and mail is held for 30 days before being purged.
troubleshooting.fix: Wait five minutes, then open the Paimon menu → Mail. If still missing after 30 minutes, the issue is almost always that you redeemed on the wrong server. Re-check the server you selected on the redemption portal against the server your character actually lives on.

troubleshooting.symptom: Portal says 'Account does not meet redemption requirements'
troubleshooting.cause: Your account is below Adventure Rank 10.
troubleshooting.fix: Keep playing the opening Mondstadt arc. Most players hit AR 10 within the first hour of the campaign. Codes redeemed before AR 10 are simply rejected — none are consumed.

troubleshooting.symptom: I want to redeem on a friend's account
troubleshooting.cause: Each redemption requires the HoYoverse account login.
troubleshooting.fix: Never share your HoYoverse credentials. If you want to gift a code, send it to your friend — codes are universal and not account-bound until redeemed.

faq.question: How long do Genshin Impact codes stay active?
faq.answer: Livestream codes typically expire 24 to 48 hours after they are announced — they are the shortest-lived codes in any major live-service game. Permanent codes like `GENSHINGIFT` remain active indefinitely. Event codes (anniversary, partnership, regional event promotions) usually last between five and fourteen days. Always redeem livestream codes within minutes of the broadcast ending.

faq.question: Why does my Genshin code say 'invalid'?
faq.answer: The four common causes, in order of frequency: the code expired (most likely for any livestream code redeemed more than 48 hours after announcement), you typed it in the wrong case (Genshin codes are case-sensitive and almost always uppercase), you redeemed on the wrong server (each server is a separate registry), or your account is below Adventure Rank 10.

faq.question: Can I redeem the same code on multiple servers?
faq.answer: Yes, once per HoYoverse account per server. If you have characters on both America and Asia, the same code can be redeemed once on each server. The portal's server dropdown controls which server registry the code applies to — pick carefully because redeeming on the wrong server consumes the code without paying rewards to your active character.

faq.question: Where do my rewards go after redeeming?
faq.answer: Primogems, Mora, books, and items arrive via in-game mail within five minutes of a successful redemption. Open the Paimon menu → Mail and tap the entry labelled 'Redemption Code'. Mail is held for 30 days; after that it is purged and cannot be recovered.

faq.question: When should I save Primogems from codes?
faq.answer: Genshin Primogems carry over indefinitely with no expiry, so the optimal strategy is to bank code Primogems toward whichever banner is closest to your current pity timer or features the character you actually want. A guaranteed Five-Star costs around 14,000 Primogems at hard pity; three livestream codes (300 Primogems) cover roughly 2% of that. Even a small head start matters if you are doing the math on whether to skip a banner.

faq.question: Are there any 'secret' Genshin Impact codes not on this list?
faq.answer: No. Every redemption code is announced through the official HoYoverse channels — livestream, Twitter / X, HoYoLab — before it goes live. If a YouTube thumbnail promises a 'secret' or 'leaked' code, it is almost always either a known code or a clickbait link to a phishing site. Never enter your HoYoverse credentials anywhere other than `hoyoverse.com` domains.

faq.question: Do codes work for Honkai: Star Rail or Zenless Zone Zero?
faq.answer: No. Each HoYoverse game has its own redemption portal and its own codes. The Honkai: Star Rail portal is at [hsr.hoyoverse.com/gift](https://hsr.hoyoverse.com/gift) — we maintain a separate codes page for that game.

faq.question: Can I get banned for using codes?
faq.answer: No. Codes are an official feature of the redemption portal, run directly by HoYoverse. The only ban-relevant rule around codes is that you should never share your HoYoverse credentials to redeem on another player's behalf — that violates the HoYoverse Terms of Service, regardless of whether codes are involved.
